examples.en: The teacher will dictate the words and we write them down.
examples.zh: 老师会念出单词，我们把它们写下来。

examples.en: The light turns on when the sensor detects movement.
examples.zh: 当传感器探测到移动时，灯就会亮起。

examples.en: We should not judge people by a simple stereotype.
examples.zh: 我们不应该用简单的刻板印象去评判他人。

examples.en: Please read the user manual before using the machine.
examples.zh: 使用这台机器前请先阅读用户手册。

examples.en: She had to kneel down to pick up the coin.
examples.zh: 她不得不跪下来捡起那枚硬币。

examples.en: The plaintiff asked the court for fair compensation.
examples.zh: 原告请求法庭给予公平的赔偿。

examples.en: I need to wash a big pile of laundry today.
examples.zh: 我今天得洗一大堆要洗的衣服。

examples.en: His grandfather served at a famous naval base.
examples.zh: 他的祖父曾在一个著名的海军基地服役。

examples.en: The officer kept a pistol at his side.
examples.zh: 那名警官把一把手枪别在身边。

examples.en: He offered a sincere apology for being late.
examples.zh: 他为迟到真诚地道了歉。

examples.en: The dean welcomed all the new students to the college.
examples.zh: 院长欢迎所有新生来到学院。

examples.en: She read a letter from her beloved every night.
examples.zh: 她每天晚上都读一封她心爱之人的来信。

examples.en: The clown tried to entertain the children at the party.
examples.zh: 小丑在聚会上努力逗孩子们开心。

examples.en: You can find more information on our official website.
examples.zh: 你可以在我们的官方网站上找到更多信息。

examples.en: The dog ran to retrieve the ball from the water.
examples.zh: 那只狗跑去把球从水里叼回来。

examples.en: The concert was a tribute to the great singer.
examples.zh: 这场音乐会是对这位伟大歌手的致敬。

examples.en: A heavy bomber flew low over the old city.
examples.zh: 一架重型轰炸机低低地飞过这座老城。

examples.en: My sister is studying overseas this year.
examples.zh: 我姐姐今年在海外留学。

examples.en: He told us a bizarre story about a talking cat.
examples.zh: 他给我们讲了一个关于会说话的猫的离奇故事。

examples.en: The team decided to nominate her for the award.
examples.zh: 团队决定提名她角逐这个奖项。

examples.en: They had to devise a new plan to save money.
examples.zh: 他们不得不设计一个新计划来省钱。

examples.en: The sailors dropped the anchor near the small island.
examples.zh: 水手们在小岛附近抛下了锚。

examples.en: We made a fair bargain and both felt happy.
examples.zh: 我们达成了一笔公平的交易，双方都很满意。

examples.en: I am skeptical about his promise to come early.
examples.zh: 我对他早点来的承诺持怀疑态度。

examples.en: Every detail of the plan came under close scrutiny.
examples.zh: 计划的每个细节都受到了仔细的审查。

examples.en: She tried hard to suppress her anger at work.
examples.zh: 她努力压抑住自己在工作中的怒火。

examples.en: The old door handle was made of shiny brass.
examples.zh: 那个旧门把手是用发亮的黄铜做的。

examples.en: It was an unfortunate accident that hurt no one.
examples.zh: 那是一场没有伤到任何人的不幸事故。

examples.en: The dentist had to extract one of my teeth.
examples.zh: 牙医不得不拔掉我的一颗牙。

examples.en: She took an intensive English course over the summer.
examples.zh: 她在暑假上了一个强化英语课程。

examples.en: He studied engineering at the local tech.
examples.zh: 他在当地的技术学院学习工程。

examples.en: His shaking hands betrayed how nervous he was.
examples.zh: 他颤抖的双手暴露了他有多紧张。

examples.en: Mix the flour and water to a smooth consistency.
examples.zh: 把面粉和水搅拌到顺滑的稠度。

examples.en: Too much bureaucracy makes simple tasks very slow.
examples.zh: 过多的官僚作风让简单的事情变得非常缓慢。

examples.en: The museum has an interactive screen for children.
examples.zh: 博物馆有一块供孩子使用的交互式屏幕。

examples.en: She found a clever way to solve the puzzle.
examples.zh: 她想出了一个聪明的办法来解开这个谜题。

examples.en: The loser of the game shook hands and smiled.
examples.zh: 比赛的失败者握了握手，露出了微笑。

examples.en: She wrote a thoughtful critique of the new film.
examples.zh: 她为这部新电影写了一篇深思熟虑的评论。

examples.en: All the passengers are now safely aboard the ship.
examples.zh: 所有乘客现在都安全地登上了船。

examples.en: She showed great compassion for the homeless man.
examples.zh: 她对那个无家可归的人表现出极大的同情。

examples.en: The printer can reproduce the photo in full color.
examples.zh: 这台打印机能用全彩复制这张照片。

examples.en: The whole congregation stood up to sing together.
examples.zh: 全体会众都站起来一起唱歌。

examples.en: Regular exercise is beneficial to your health.
examples.zh: 经常锻炼对你的健康有益。

examples.en: There was an awkward silence after his question.
examples.zh: 他提问之后出现了一阵尴尬的沉默。

examples.en: A small worm crawled slowly across the wet soil.
examples.zh: 一条小虫子在湿润的泥土上慢慢爬过。

examples.en: A sudden storm added a complication to our trip.
examples.zh: 一场突如其来的暴风雨给我们的旅行增添了麻烦。

examples.en: The police found marijuana hidden in the old car.
examples.zh: 警察在那辆旧车里发现了藏着的大麻。

examples.en: He is a legendary player loved by many fans.
examples.zh: 他是一位深受众多球迷喜爱的传奇球员。

examples.en: Local farmers joined the militia to defend the town.
examples.zh: 当地的农民加入了民兵组织来保卫城镇。

examples.en: The young composer wrote music for the school play.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的作曲家为学校的话剧谱了曲。

examples.en: We ate authentic Italian food at a small restaurant.
examples.zh: 我们在一家小餐馆吃了正宗的意大利菜。

examples.en: Both sides made a small concession to reach a deal.
examples.zh: 双方都做出了小小的让步以达成协议。

examples.en: The restoration of the old church took two years.
examples.zh: 这座古老教堂的修复工作花了两年时间。

examples.en: He felt sad after the rejection of his idea.
examples.zh: 他的想法被拒绝后，他感到很难过。

examples.en: During his tenure as mayor, the city grew quickly.
examples.zh: 在他担任市长期间，这座城市发展迅速。

examples.en: The huge church has a beautiful golden dome.
examples.zh: 这座巨大的教堂有一个美丽的金色圆顶。

examples.en: The light in this room is inadequate for reading.
examples.zh: 这个房间的光线不足以阅读。

examples.en: The thief ran away with her shopping bag.
examples.zh: 那个小偷拿着她的购物袋跑了。

examples.en: The newspaper wrote an editorial about the new law.
examples.zh: 这家报纸就这项新法律写了一篇社论。

examples.en: She put her coat and bag inside her locker.
examples.zh: 她把外套和包放进了自己的储物柜里。

examples.en: The leaves turn red and gold in autumn.
examples.zh: 秋天，树叶会变成红色和金色。

examples.en: He failed the test and subsequently studied harder.
examples.zh: 他考试没通过，随后学习更加努力了。

examples.en: The merger of the two banks made big news.
examples.zh: 这两家银行的合并成了大新闻。

examples.en: A faithful dog will wait for its owner every day.
examples.zh: 一只忠实的狗每天都会等着它的主人。

examples.en: That quiet old cafe was once our favorite haunt.
examples.zh: 那家安静的老咖啡馆曾是我们最爱去的地方。

examples.en: He drew a crude map on the back of a napkin.
examples.zh: 他在餐巾纸背面画了一张粗糙的地图。

examples.en: The sheriff arrived to keep the crowd calm.
examples.zh: 治安官赶来维持人群的秩序。

examples.en: This old song can evoke happy childhood memories.
examples.zh: 这首老歌能唤起快乐的童年记忆。

examples.en: We celebrated the completion of the new bridge.
examples.zh: 我们庆祝了这座新桥的竣工。

examples.en: He is my best pal from primary school.
examples.zh: 他是我小学时最好的伙伴。

examples.en: The trader sold fresh fruit at the morning market.
examples.zh: 那位商人在早市上卖新鲜水果。

examples.en: She gave an affirmative answer to his question.
examples.zh: 她对他的问题给出了肯定的回答。

examples.en: The nurse found a vein and gave him the injection.
examples.zh: 护士找到一根静脉，给他打了针。

examples.en: The soldiers chose to surrender after the long battle.
examples.zh: 经过漫长的战斗后，士兵们选择了投降。

examples.en: He still has a small scar above his eye.
examples.zh: 他的眼睛上方仍有一道小疤痕。

examples.en: There is a wide variance in the students' test scores.
examples.zh: 学生们的考试成绩差异很大。

examples.en: There was a sudden surge in online sales last month.
examples.zh: 上个月网上销售额突然激增。

examples.en: The young sailor missed his family back home.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的水手思念着家乡的亲人。

examples.en: An officer came to inspect the new factory.
examples.zh: 一名官员来检查这座新工厂。

examples.en: He listened to the match commentary on the radio.
examples.zh: 他在收音机里听比赛解说。

examples.en: She is a loyal follower of that famous teacher.
examples.zh: 她是那位著名老师的忠实追随者。

examples.en: Shake the bottle to mix the suspension well.
examples.zh: 摇一摇瓶子，把悬浮液混合均匀。

examples.en: Tourists visited the grand old imperial palace.
examples.zh: 游客们参观了宏伟古老的皇宫。

examples.en: The company agreed to compensate him for the loss.
examples.zh: 公司同意补偿他的损失。

examples.en: He shouted a rude word like "fuck" when he got hurt.
examples.zh: 他受伤时骂了一句像“他妈的”这样的粗话。

examples.en: The helicopter can hover above the building.
examples.zh: 直升机可以在大楼上方盘旋。

examples.en: The scientists found a dinosaur fossil in the rock.
examples.zh: 科学家们在岩石中发现了一块恐龙化石。

examples.en: We caught a fresh trout in the cold river.
examples.zh: 我们在冰冷的河里钓到了一条新鲜的鳟鱼。

examples.en: His joke was inappropriate for such a serious meeting.
examples.zh: 他的玩笑在这么严肃的会议上很不合适。

examples.en: The cowboy rode his horse across the wide field.
examples.zh: 那个牛仔骑着马穿过宽阔的田野。

examples.en: We need a viable plan that we can really afford.
examples.zh: 我们需要一个真正负担得起的可行计划。

examples.en: Could you clarify what you mean by that word?
examples.zh: 你能解释一下那个词是什么意思吗？

examples.en: She made a quick sketch of the old bridge.
examples.zh: 她为那座老桥画了一幅快速的素描。

examples.en: There are countless stars in the night sky.
examples.zh: 夜空中有数不清的星星。

examples.en: These wires are made of copper to carry electricity.
examples.zh: 这些电线是用铜制成的，用来导电。

examples.en: We had a nice chat over a cup of tea.
examples.zh: 我们一边喝茶一边愉快地聊天。

examples.en: Everyone is excited about the upcoming holiday.
examples.zh: 大家都对即将到来的假期感到兴奋。

examples.en: In bright light, the pupil of the eye gets smaller.
examples.zh: 在强光下，眼睛的瞳孔会变小。

examples.en: She finished in ninth place in the race.
examples.zh: 她在比赛中获得了第九名。

examples.en: We must strive to do our best every day.
examples.zh: 我们必须每天都努力做到最好。

examples.en: Do not neglect your homework before the exam.
examples.zh: 考试前不要忽视你的作业。

examples.en: The sick child stayed in the children's ward.
examples.zh: 生病的孩子住在儿童病房里。

examples.en: Modern warfare often uses planes and computers.
examples.zh: 现代战争常常使用飞机和电脑。

examples.en: The children built a small mound of sand at the beach.
examples.zh: 孩子们在海滩上堆了一个小沙堆。

examples.en: The door shut with a loud bang.
examples.zh: 门砰的一声关上了。

examples.en: Please tilt your head back a little.
examples.zh: 请把头稍微向后倾斜一点。

examples.en: Two men tried to rob the small shop at night.
examples.zh: 两个男子夜里试图抢劫那家小店。

examples.en: The hotel room was clean and reasonably cheap.
examples.zh: 酒店房间干净，价格也相当便宜。

examples.en: We visited a medieval castle on the hill.
examples.zh: 我们参观了山上一座中世纪的城堡。

examples.en: Her advocacy for clean water helped many villages.
examples.zh: 她对清洁饮水的倡导帮助了许多村庄。

examples.en: The biologist studied the rare fish in the lake.
examples.zh: 这位生物学家研究湖中稀有的鱼。

examples.en: The prize had no monetary value, only honor.
examples.zh: 这个奖没有金钱价值，只有荣誉。

examples.en: Every learner makes mistakes while studying English.
examples.zh: 每个学习者在学英语时都会犯错误。

examples.en: He tied a tight knot in the rope.
examples.zh: 他在绳子上打了一个紧紧的结。

examples.en: The doctor gave her an antibiotic for the infection.
examples.zh: 医生给她开了抗生素来治疗感染。

examples.en: Hard work brought prosperity to the small town.
examples.zh: 辛勤的工作给这个小镇带来了繁荣。

examples.en: Dust will accumulate if you never clean the room.
examples.zh: 如果你从不打扫房间，灰尘就会堆积起来。

examples.en: In the story, a brave knight fought a fierce dragon.
examples.zh: 在故事里，一位勇敢的骑士与一条凶猛的龙搏斗。

examples.en: They changed the electoral rules before the vote.
examples.zh: 他们在投票前修改了选举规则。

examples.en: The state will prosecute the man for the theft.
examples.zh: 州政府将就这起盗窃案起诉这名男子。

examples.en: A teacher had to intervene to stop the fight.
examples.zh: 一位老师不得不出面干预来制止打架。

examples.en: A soft glow filled the room as the sun set.
examples.zh: 夕阳西下时，一片柔和的光辉充满了房间。

examples.en: These rules embody the values of our school.
examples.zh: 这些规则体现了我们学校的价值观。

examples.en: The film was so dull that I fell asleep.
examples.zh: 这部电影太无聊了，我都睡着了。

examples.en: A soft red rug lay in front of the fireplace.
examples.zh: 壁炉前铺着一块柔软的红色小地毯。

examples.en: The police made a sudden raid on the warehouse.
examples.zh: 警察对仓库进行了突然的搜查。

examples.en: The queen wore a gold crown on her head.
examples.zh: 女王头上戴着一顶金色的王冠。

examples.en: The bag looked real, but it was a cheap fake.
examples.zh: 这个包看起来是真的，但其实是廉价的假货。

examples.en: The cat began to creep slowly toward the bird.
examples.zh: 那只猫开始慢慢地朝小鸟爬过去。

examples.en: A small crab moved sideways along the wet sand.
examples.zh: 一只小螃蟹沿着湿沙横着爬行。

examples.en: This kind teacher is worthy of our deep respect.
examples.zh: 这位善良的老师值得我们深深的尊敬。

examples.en: Water is made of hydrogen and oxygen.
examples.zh: 水是由氢和氧构成的。

examples.en: There is a high probability of rain tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天下雨的概率很高。

examples.en: She added some vinegar to the salad dressing.
examples.zh: 她在沙拉酱里加了一点醋。

examples.en: Under capitalism, most companies are privately owned.
examples.zh: 在资本主义制度下，大多数公司都是私人所有的。

examples.en: The weather advisory warned people about the storm.
examples.zh: 天气预警提醒人们注意这场风暴。

examples.en: She is the main organizer of the school festival.
examples.zh: 她是学校节日活动的主要组织者。

examples.en: Honey tea is a simple remedy for a sore throat.
examples.zh: 蜂蜜茶是治疗喉咙痛的一个简单方法。

examples.en: His inability to swim kept him out of the water.
examples.zh: 他不会游泳，所以一直待在水外。

examples.en: He saw a bad smash between two cars on the road.
examples.zh: 他在路上看到两辆车严重相撞。

examples.en: The writer sent her manuscript to the publisher.
examples.zh: 这位作家把她的手稿寄给了出版商。

examples.en: The story teaches children about morality and honesty.
examples.zh: 这个故事教孩子们懂得道德和诚实。

examples.en: She felt hopeful about her new job.
examples.zh: 她对自己的新工作充满希望。

examples.en: They had a small disagreement about the plan.
examples.zh: 他们对这个计划有一点分歧。

examples.en: She has a fancy that one day she will fly.
examples.zh: 她有一个幻想，总有一天她会飞翔。

examples.en: Wearing a seat belt in the car is mandatory.
examples.zh: 在车里系安全带是强制性的。

examples.en: We met by chance, purely by accident.
examples.zh: 我们是偶然相遇的，纯粹是意外。

examples.en: He made a perfect dive into the swimming pool.
examples.zh: 他完美地跳入了游泳池。

examples.en: The shop will advertise its new products on TV.
examples.zh: 这家商店将在电视上为新产品做广告。

examples.en: She mixed some baking soda into the cake batter.
examples.zh: 她在蛋糕面糊里加了一些小苏打。

examples.en: His deep bass voice filled the whole room.
examples.zh: 他低沉的男低音充满了整个房间。

examples.en: We chose the lesser of two difficult options.
examples.zh: 我们在两个艰难的选择中挑了较轻的一个。

examples.en: She wore shiny new shoes to the party.
examples.zh: 她穿着一双亮闪闪的新鞋去参加聚会。

examples.en: The manager sent a short memo to all staff.
examples.zh: 经理给所有员工发了一份简短的备忘录。

examples.en: We threw out a lot of old junk from the garage.
examples.zh: 我们从车库里扔掉了很多旧垃圾。

examples.en: The bright lights can stun a deer at night.
examples.zh: 夜里明亮的灯光会让一只鹿惊呆。

examples.en: These apples take many weeks to fully mature.
examples.zh: 这些苹果要好几个星期才能完全成熟。

examples.en: This factory will manufacture toys for children.
examples.zh: 这家工厂将为孩子们制造玩具。

examples.en: She felt poorly and stayed home from school.
examples.zh: 她感觉不舒服，没去上学待在家里。

examples.en: The old man showed great affection for his grandson.
examples.zh: 这位老人对他的孙子表现出深深的喜爱。

examples.en: She put a colorful stamp on the letter.
examples.zh: 她在信上贴了一枚彩色的邮票。

examples.en: The ancient philosopher taught his students to think.
examples.zh: 这位古代哲学家教他的学生思考。

examples.en: She had to clutch the rail to keep her balance.
examples.zh: 她不得不抓住栏杆来保持平衡。

examples.en: He walked silently into the dark room.
examples.zh: 他静静地走进黑暗的房间。

examples.en: Our car had a breakdown on the busy highway.
examples.zh: 我们的车在繁忙的高速公路上抛锚了。

examples.en: He tried to conceal the gift behind his back.
examples.zh: 他试图把礼物藏在背后。

examples.en: Her hair began to curl in the warm, wet air.
examples.zh: 在温暖潮湿的空气中，她的头发开始卷曲起来。

examples.en: Drinking water is good for your kidney.
examples.zh: 多喝水对你的肾脏有好处。

examples.en: Her birthday is on the nineteenth of May.
examples.zh: 她的生日是五月十九号。

examples.en: We saw the goodness in her kind actions.
examples.zh: 我们从她善良的行为中看到了善意。

examples.en: The patient recovered remarkably fast after surgery.
examples.zh: 病人在手术后恢复得非常快。

examples.en: The program helped improve literacy among adults.
examples.zh: 这个项目帮助提高了成年人的读写能力。

examples.en: We took a taxi to the airport early this morning.
examples.zh: 今天一大早我们坐出租车去了机场。

examples.en: She believed it was her destiny to be a teacher.
examples.zh: 她相信当老师是她的命运。

examples.en: We learned about rivers and mountains in geography class.
examples.zh: 我们在地理课上学习了河流和山脉。

examples.en: She sang a beautiful solo at the concert.
examples.zh: 她在音乐会上独唱了一首优美的曲子。

examples.en: There is a small leak in the kitchen pipe.
examples.zh: 厨房的水管有一个小漏洞。

examples.en: They grow tomatoes in a warm glass greenhouse.
examples.zh: 他们在温暖的玻璃温室里种番茄。

examples.en: The country spent a trillion dollars on the project.
examples.zh: 这个国家在这个项目上花了一万亿美元。

examples.en: The new law was passed by parliament last week.
examples.zh: 这项新法律上周由议会通过了。

examples.en: The family tried to cut its monthly expenditure.
examples.zh: 这个家庭努力削减每月的开支。

examples.en: The police opened a homicide case in the city.
examples.zh: 警方在市里立了一起凶杀案。

examples.en: A herd of cows grazed quietly in the field.
examples.zh: 一群牛在田野里安静地吃草。

examples.en: She is passionate about painting and art.
examples.zh: 她对绘画和艺术充满热情。

examples.en: The teacher told us an old biblical story.
examples.zh: 老师给我们讲了一个古老的圣经故事。

examples.en: His addiction to video games hurt his studies.
examples.zh: 他对电子游戏的瘾影响了他的学业。

examples.en: Reporters started a probe into the company's money.
examples.zh: 记者们开始调查这家公司的资金问题。

examples.en: She went to see a psychiatrist about her fears.
examples.zh: 她去看精神科医生，谈她的恐惧。

examples.en: A long pipeline carries water across the desert.
examples.zh: 一条长长的管道把水输送过沙漠。

examples.en: She pulled the hood over her head in the rain.
examples.zh: 下雨时她把兜帽拉到头上。

examples.en: An atom is far too small to see with our eyes.
examples.zh: 原子太小了，我们的眼睛根本看不见。

examples.en: The teacher was positively thrilled with our results.
examples.zh: 老师对我们的成绩简直是欣喜若狂。

examples.en: I had a quick snack before the long meeting.
examples.zh: 在漫长的会议前我吃了点零食。

examples.en: Many migrant workers came to the city for jobs.
examples.zh: 许多外来务工者来到城市找工作。

examples.en: Her competence in math impressed all the teachers.
examples.zh: 她在数学方面的能力给所有老师留下了深刻印象。

examples.en: He takes a vitamin supplement every morning.
examples.zh: 他每天早上吃一片维生素补充剂。

examples.en: The pen ran out of ink in the middle of the test.
examples.zh: 考试中途，这支笔没墨水了。

examples.en: The bad news caused her great distress.
examples.zh: 这个坏消息让她非常苦恼。

examples.en: Every homeowner on the street must pay the fee.
examples.zh: 这条街上的每位房主都必须缴纳这笔费用。

examples.en: The film is an adaptation of a famous old novel.
examples.zh: 这部电影改编自一部著名的老小说。
